target.statement: Zero-shot image-to-text retrieval R@1 on Flickr30K for the GLSCL model (Ours (GLSCL)): 79.96
target.table_ref: Table 2, row 'Ours (GLSCL)' under 'Evaluate pre-trained models directly', column 'IR@1'

compute.basis: The target requires the full GLSCL pre-trained checkpoint, which was produced by 100k steps of image-text pre-training with batch size 4096 on 64 A100 GPUs (plus 10k steps of video pre-training); reproducing this on a single 8-core CPU laptop is infeasible, and even fine-tuning/evaluating the released checkpoint would need a GPU and large downloads.

blockers: Pre-training the model requires 64 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for 100k steps (batch size 4096), far beyond a laptop.
The target is a zero-shot result from the pre-trained checkpoint; without the released checkpoint, the full pre-training must be reproduced.
Even if a checkpoint is released, evaluation requires downloading large pre-trained encoders (CLIP-ViT, RoBERTa) and the Flickr30K dataset, and running a large fusion model on GPU.
No GPU available on the target laptop; the model cannot reasonably run on CPU within hours.
title: Global and Local Semantic Completion Learning for Vision-Language Pre-training
